input.subject: Monkey D. Luffy
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Approved design direction: long-range direct melee contact using stretched fists, not traveling ammunition. Base Gum-Gum Pistol roughly 45 reach. The ONLY three upgrade paths are Conqueror Haki, Observation Haki, Armament Haki. Shared form access based on highest tier on ANY path: Gear Second at 1, Gear Third at 2, Gear Fourth variants Boundman/Snakeman/Tankman at 3, Gear Fifth at 5. Base is not Gear First. Provide different replacement attack profiles and a contextual Technique for these forms; research named moves. Gear II+III is a contextual Technique replacement after tier 2, not simultaneous forms. One shared bounded stamina resource, recovery in base, positive drain in Gears, reentry delay and shared Technique cooldown. Conqueror controls weak-willed stunnable enemies then coating; Observation detects concealed enemies and improves reach/targeting/cadence; Armament hardening, armor penetration, emission/internal damage. Explicitly disclose selectable Tankman without a feeding prerequisite as game adaptation, and bounded Fifth rubberization rather than unrestricted reality alteration. Preserve all these design decisions, research whether individual move names are supported.

gaps: The supplied pages do not provide the requested game schema or define executable fields for resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, cooldowns, prices, or upgrade purchases.

No supplied source establishes the requested numerical tuning, including approximately 45 reach, damage values, world-unit ranges, stamina capacity, drain rates, recovery rates, reentry delay, or shared Technique cooldown.
The requested exactly three five-purchase paths and legal maximum 5-2-0 are design requirements, not character evidence.

The supplied evidence supports many named techniques but does not exhaustively verify every individual move name requested for implementation, especially any proposed contextual Technique replacements for each Gear form.
The source describes multiple Gear forms and their differences, but it does not provide a complete canonical rule for selecting or switching among all forms in the requested game structure.

The supplied source describes Gear Fifth's awakening and environmental rubberization but does not establish unrestricted reality alteration; stronger claims about imagination creating any desired effect should not be treated as verified for this cutoff.
The supplied pages do not establish a precise canonical numerical measure for Luffy's attack range, speed, damage, stamina, or durability.
The abilities page contains material from after Wano, including later arcs and later named developments. Those later facts were excluded from the selected continuity record.

The supplied official character page contains broad promotional summaries and does not independently document the full technical details of every Haki application, named technique, transformation limitation, or weakness.
No supplied page verifies that all requested status effects, concealed-enemy detection behavior, air-target rules, or stationary tower-combat interactions are canon traits of Luffy.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.
